actions.action: Check soil moisture with a finger before each watering
Water at the soil around the base only when the top layer is dry
Move plant to a cool (10–15°C), bright spot away from heaters and direct sun
Weekly remove dead flowers and yellowing or spotted leaves with clean scissors
If grey fuzz or mushy brown stems appear, remove affected parts

reason: The answer treats heat and wet leaves as the main problem and mentions natural flower fading only as secondary, so it is a partial diagnosis and a false alarm; the deadheading fix is there but buried among other steps, and none of the advice is likely to harm the plant.
